prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web landing-page composition option, 1440×900 landscape
Primary request: Render the complete edge-to-edge first viewport for “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”. A center owner, teacher or staff member should see how work moves through one teaching day and sign in without leaving the opening screen.
Real content: product “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”; headline “Mọi ca dạy, trên cùng một nhịp”; stages “Duyệt trung tâm”, “Phân quyền”, “Xếp lịch”, “Điểm danh”; form “Tên đăng nhập”, “Mật khẩu”, “Đăng nhập”, “Quên mật khẩu?”; proof data “Toán 9A · 07:30–09:00 · P.101”, “22 / 24 học sinh có mặt”, “Trung tâm đã được phê duyệt”.
Composition concept: route-led. One enormous ruled planner canvas fills the screen. A single S-shaped green day-line sweeps from the upper margin to the lower edge, carrying four unequal stations rather than a grid of cards. The working sign-in form is the enlarged first station and remains the unmistakable primary action; a live class, compact timetable, and attendance tally occupy later stations along the same line. The next page edge peeks in below, proving the world continues. Product mark, navigation “Tổng quan · Vận hành · Bảo mật”, date, and system health are written into the planner’s quiet top margin.
Visual law: cool white ruled paper, deep navy ink, jade active states, apricot upcoming, vermilion exceptions. Strong Vietnamese-friendly grotesk, numbered time tabs, spare handwritten annotations, flat paper layers with restrained depth.
Constraints: real functional web UI, crisp Vietnamese, one dominant sweeping route, no centered headline above equal cards, no split hero, no dashboard sidebar, no photograph or desk, no device/browser frame, no people, no glassmorphism, no watermark.
